description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GLAccountDuplicateException' used within the accounting module of the Fineract project. It extends a base exception to signal duplicate GL account errors based on GL codes.

classes.name: GLAccountDuplicateException
classes.description: A runtime exception thrown when a GL Account with a duplicate GL code is detected within the respective domain context.

methods.name: GLAccountDuplicateException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a specific GL code, indicating a duplicate GL account exists.
